name: Felix Liu
description: Academic Pages portfolio for Felix Liu — decision-oriented analytics spanning causal inference, risk modeling, extreme value theory, and computational social science. Measured from https://sousekil.github.io/.

logo.notes: No inline header/nav SVG exists on the live site; the masthead is a text wordmark. Primary mark is the academic mortarboard favicon (fill #36c). The circular avatar photo is the personal masthead lockup. favicon-1.svg is the GitHub Octocats mark retained as a source-system alternate; og-image-4.png is the repository social-card fallback.

colors.name: Footer Mist
colors.usage: footer, thead, card borders, raised bands (--global-footer-bg-color, --global-border-color)

colors.name: Deep Teal
colors.usage: info emphasis ($info-color) and link-hover base (--global-link-color-hover mixes from this)

display.notes: Measured from main.css; used for headings, masthead, nav, buttons, and UI chrome.

body.notes: Live CSS override in assets/css/style.scss sets 'Times New Roman', sans-serif; canonical stack preserves serif fallbacks.

mono.notes: Used for inline code and preformatted blocks.

voice.tone: Calm academic-professional: lead with the research question, method, and outcome. Prefer measured claims, research framing, and role-ready signals over hype.
messagingPillars: Causal inference, risk modeling, and extreme value methods
Selected work with clear questions, methods, and outcomes
Open to Data Scientist, Actuarial Analyst, and Risk Analytics roles

imagery.style: Research figures, network graphs, time-series charts, project-slide hero images, and restrained academic portfolio photography
subjects: project title slides and talk screenshots
imagery.treatment: Clean white or charcoal canvas; charts with muted axes; teal accents used sparingly for links and highlights; photography desaturated or natural; project thumbnails 6px radius with soft shadow, summary cards 16px radius with a light surface border

samples.caption: Women's Names in Ancient China project slide

layout.spacing: 8px baseline with 1.5 body line-height; masthead 70px; content max-width centered; section gaps ~3rem; grid gaps 1rem
postureRules: Light academic canvas (#fff) with charcoal dark theme (#474747) toggle
Serif body (Times New Roman) + system sans display for headings and UI chrome
Single teal accent for links and primary actions; gray base for default buttons (#7a8288)
Base radius 4px on buttons and code chips; summary/project cards use 16px radius with a soft 12px/32px shadow
Cards use a 1px surface-colored border (#f2f3f3) on white background
Sidebar + masthead shell (Minimal Mistakes / Academic Pages): 1024px sidebar breakpoint
Homepage hero title uses fluid clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 4.4rem) with tight 1.02 line-height
Section grids use CSS auto-fit (minmax 180px–250px) for snapshots and project cards
Project cards follow a Question / Method / Result pattern with compact action rows
